verdict: Cost per lead spiked this week; spend outran lead volume.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 29 leads at an average cost of $11.06 per lead, but the most recent 7 days showed a 44% jump in cost per lead as spend rose 34% while leads dipped 7% — spend is running ahead of results. The concentration of budget in a single campaign (68% of all spend) means there is no second campaign to check efficiency against, and that is being addressed by testing additional campaign structure. Two of your three Google Business Profile listings are generating calls at a fraction of the rate of the third — those profiles are being reviewed and optimized to close the gap. Lead pipeline data was unavailable this cycle due to an authentication issue that is being resolved, so intake and conversion numbers will be restored next report.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead rose 44% in the past 7 days, driven by spend increasing faster than lead volume with no efficiency gain.
watch_item.fix: Campaign structure is being expanded so spend is no longer concentrated in a single campaign, giving clearer efficiency benchmarks and more room to optimize.
